observableChatMethodSpecification.starterComponent: Compare both probable or confirmed starters using only timestamped pregame starter identity, recent prior-game performance, season rates, handedness if certified, and status confidence.
observableChatMethodSpecification.offenseComponent: Compare team offense using season and recent prior-game team/player offensive evidence; do not include same-game outcomes.
observableChatMethodSpecification.bullpenComponent: Compare relief quality and recent workload from prior games only; missing closer/high-leverage role evidence remains null.
observableChatMethodSpecification.splitsComponent: Use offensive/pitcher handedness splits only after player handedness and split source timestamps are certified.
observableChatMethodSpecification.lineupComponent: Use MORNING projected/expected lineup only as projected, and FINAL_PREGAME confirmed lineup only if source timestamp is before start.
observableChatMethodSpecification.injuryComponent: Use no injury edge until an approved timestamped injury source exists.
observableChatMethodSpecification.weatherParkComponent: Use park and weather context only from stored pregame source timestamps; unavailable weather remains missing.
observableChatMethodSpecification.marketComponent: Compare only exact event, market, selection, line, sportsbook, and odds timestamp.
observableChatMethodSpecification.recentFormComponent: Use rolling prior games only, with source dates strictly before target start.
observableChatMethodSpecification.priceValueComponent: Report implied probability and edge versus a calibrated probability only when that probability is derived by a certified model; otherwise report rank/score only.

scorecardDesign.probabilityOutputPolicy: Do not emit calibrated probability until historical or forward frozen ledger evidence supports calibration. Persist score, rank, component evidence, completeness, and confidence tier only.

temporalContracts.historicalRule: Every feature source timestamp must be strictly before target_event_start_time.

mayContain: latest exact-line market price before cutoff

comparisonContract.bookPolicy: Book-specific comparisons must retain sportsbook identity. Cross-book aggregation requires explicit best-price policy.
comparisonContract.mismatchedLinePolicy: Do not compare or bind old-line probability to moved-line price.

evaluationContract.accuracyClaimPolicy: No 80 percent accuracy claim without frozen pregame ledger evidence.

priorityRecommendation.reason: Highest information value because it freezes observable evidence before any model comparison.
